scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloud-api/core && npm run build -w @cloud-api/proxy && npm run build:cf -w @cloud-api/admin
scripts.build:proxy: npm run build -w @cloud-api/core && npm run build -w @cloud-api/proxy
scripts.build:admin: npm run build -w @cloud-api/core && npm run build:cf -w @cloud-api/admin
scripts.deploy:proxy: npm run gen:wrangler -- --remote && npm run deploy -w @cloud-api/proxy
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build -w @cloud-api/core && npm run gen:wrangler -- --remote && npm run deploy -w @cloud-api/admin
scripts.db:migrate: npm run gen:wrangler && node scripts/deploy/wrangler-d1-cli.mjs migrations apply --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run gen:wrangler -- --remote && node scripts/deploy/wrangler-d1-cli.mjs migrations apply --remote
scripts.db:query: npm run gen:wrangler && node scripts/deploy/wrangler-d1-cli.mjs execute --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --command
scripts.db:query:remote: npm run gen:wrangler -- --remote && node scripts/deploy/wrangler-d1-cli.mjs execute --remote --command
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:deploy && npm run test:unit -w @cloud-api/core && npm run test:unit -w @cloud-api/proxy && npm run test:unit -w @cloud-api/admin
